newsitem.title: USA: O'Reilly Automotive sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: O'Reilly Automotive sets stock split.

text.p: O'Reilly Automotive Inc said Wednesday its board declared a two-for-one stock split in the form of a 100 percent stock dividend to all shareholders of record as of the close of business on July 31.
The company said it expects the shares will be made available to shareholders on or about August 31.

"The current per share price level of our common stock reflects the strong financial performance of O'Reilly Automotive since our initial public offering in April 1993," David O'Reilly, president, said in a statement. "This stock dividend is indicative of our expectations for continued growth."
O'Reilly Automotive is a specialty retailer and supplier of automotive aftermarket parts, tools, supplies, equipment and accessories.
